title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces — Delivery and Setup Standards Card
content:
Delivery standards for Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces, by bed class: the business days from a complete order to delivery; whether delivery is guaranteed on the day of hospital discharge for orders received by noon; whether a side-rail entrapment check must be documented at delivery and at each service visit; and the calendar months a written order stays usable to deliver the bed.

| Bed class | Business days from a complete order to delivery | Same-day delivery on the day of hospital discharge | Side-rail entrapment check documented at delivery and at each service visit | Calendar months a written order stays usable to deliver the bed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | 1 | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | 1 | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | 1 | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | 1 | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | 2 | No | Yes | 12 |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | 3 | No | Yes | 12 |

## Card notes

**Lead time.** The four 36-inch classes (E0250, E0255, E0260, E0265) carry a lead of 1 business day from a complete order to delivery; the Heavy-Duty class 2 business days; the Extra Heavy-Duty class 3 business days.

**Hospital discharge.** The same-day value is Yes for the E0250, E0255, E0260 and E0265 classes and No for the Heavy-Duty (E0303) and Extra Heavy-Duty (E0304) classes. The value is defined as whether delivery is guaranteed on the day of hospital discharge for orders received by noon.

**Entrapment check.** Every class carries Yes: a side-rail entrapment check must be documented at delivery and at each service visit.

**Written order.** A written order stays usable to deliver the bed for 12 calendar months in every class.

### Side-by-side (hypothetical orders)

| Hypothetical order | Lead from a complete order | Same-day discharge value |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | 1 business day | Yes |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | 2 business days | No |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | 3 business days | No |
